title: Refuse nonexistent event dates in nonconformance history
prompt:
Fix impossible-date acceptance in lib/ohworks-nonconformance.ts. The local predicate at lines 240-241 and transition checks at lines 373-382 accept a date once Date.parse normalizes it. I reproduced a successful OPEN-to-CONTAINED transition at 2026-02-30T12:00:00Z using createNonconformanceRecord, a CONTAIN action with synthetic actor and containment text, and the investigator demo role. The impossible timestamp was retained verbatim in accepted history. lib/ohworks-demo-quality-events-view.ts:72 consumes transitions to build visible quality-event evidence.

Validate literal calendar and clock fields before accepting an event or comparing it with the previous timestamp. Reject impossible UTC dates with the existing timestamp-invalid refusal; keep the existing timestamp-not-utc behavior for otherwise valid non-UTC inputs. Preserve valid fractional seconds, leap days, transition rules, and role checks. A refusal must neither change the input record nor append history. Implement the validation locally; no shared helper or demo-view edits.

Add tests/ohworks/nonconformance-event-calendar.test.ts covering February 30 on the first event, April 31 after a valid event, non-leap February 29, and valid leap-day/fractional-second controls. Assert exact refusal and unchanged state/history, plus successful valid transitions. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks/nonconformance.test.ts tests/ohworks/nonconformance-event-calendar.test.ts tests/ohworks/demo-quality-events-view.test.ts.

Planning verification reproduced the defect and passed existing evaluator and demo-view tests. Edit only the named source and new test. Use synthetic fixtures; no credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, auth, package.json, or workflow changes. work on the assigned branch you are on.
